verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 for https://docs.github.com/llms.txt, which returns a structured GitHub Docs summary. An agent can be pointed straight at it. GitHub also publishes stable, machine-readable OpenAPI descriptions of its REST API in github/rest-api-description, though the conventional openapi.json paths on docs.github.com return 404. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining the llms.txt file and its coverage, evidence of llms-full.txt or per-page markdown versions for agents, and independent hands-on reports of agents using these docs.
